info.title: Agent Payment Firewall
info.description: Real-time guardrail proxy and risk evaluation system for autonomous AI payments.

get.description: List all mandates with remaining/reserved/spent balances (Operator-only).

get.description: Get single mandate details including real-time balances (Operator-only).

post.description: Revoke an active or frozen mandate (Operator-only).
Unfreeze a frozen mandate back to active (Operator-only).

get.description:
Retrieve the agent's most recent active mandate summary.
Requires agent authentication via X-Agent-Key.
Returns 404 if no active or valid mandate exists.

post.description:
Handle PayPal webhook notifications.

Reads exact raw bytes, verifies cryptographic signature with PayPal,
deduplicates by event_id, stores the event, links it to a PaymentIntent,
and updates budget (commit on success / release on failure).

schema.title: Response Handle Paypal Webhook Webhooks Paypal Post

post.description: Submit a payment intent for processing (Agent-authenticated).
